errors.evidence: The description incorrectly lists the country 'Латвия' (Latvia) instead of 'Литва' (Lithuania), which is what is shown on the x-axis.
The description states that the y-axis has intervals of 5, but the axis labels (0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50) clearly show intervals of 10.
In the section about Czechia, the description states the value for women is 41.84 hours, but the chart shows this value to be 43.54 hours. The value 41.84 corresponds to men in Estonia.
